pairs: Profectus inde Abraham in terram australem,
Abraham advanced from there into the southern land,
and he lived between Kadesh and Shur.
And he said about his wife Sarah:
Therefore, Abimelech, the king of Gerar,
sent for her and took her.
Venit autem Deus ad Abimelech per somnium nocte,
Then God came to Abimelech through a dream in the night,
En morieris propter mulierem quam tulisti:
“Lo, you shall die because of the woman that you have taken.
In truth, Abimelech had not touched her,
num gentem ignorantem et justam interficies?
“Lord, would you put to death a people, ignorant and just?
Did he not say to me,
In the sincerity of my heart and the purity of my hands,
et munditia manuum mearum feci hoc.
Et ego scio quod simplici corde feceris:
“And I know that you have acted with a sincere heart.
et ideo custodivi te ne peccares in me,
And therefore I kept you from sinning against me,
et non dimisi ut tangeres eam.
and I did not release you to touch her.
Nunc ergo redde viro suo uxorem,
Now therefore, return his wife to the man,
And he will pray for you,
But if you are not willing to return her,
know this: you shall die a death,
you and all that is yours.”
And immediately Abimelech, rising up in the night,
et locutus est universa verba hæc in auribus eorum,
And he spoke all these words in their hearing,
and all the men were very afraid.
Then Abimelech called also for Abraham,
How have we sinned against you,
quia induxisti super me et super regnum meum peccatum grande?
so that you would bring so great a sin upon me
You have done to us what you ought not to have done.”
so that you would do this?”
Forsitan non est timor Dei in loco isto:
Perhaps there is no fear of God in this place.
et interficient me propter uxorem meam:
And they will put me to death because of my wife.
alias autem et vere soror mea est,
Yet, in another way, she is also truly my sister,
and not the daughter of my mother,
and I took her as a wife.
Postquam autem eduxit me Deus de domo patris mei,
Then, after God led me out of my father’s house,
‘You will show this mercy to me.
you will say that I am your brother.’”
Tulit igitur Abimelech oves et boves,
Therefore, Abimelech took sheep and oxen,
and men servants and women servants,
et dedit Abraham: reddiditque illi Saram uxorem suam,
and he gave them to Abraham. And he returned his wife Sarah to him.
Dwell wherever it will please you.”
Ecce mille argenteos dedi fratri tuo,
“Behold, I have given your brother one thousand silver coins.
hoc erit tibi in velamen oculorum ad omnes qui tecum sunt, et quocumque perrexeris:
This will be for you as a veil for your eyes, to all who are with you and wherever you will travel.
And so, remember that you were taken.”
God healed Abimelech and his wife,
concluserat enim Dominus omnem vulvam domus Abimelech propter Saram uxorem Abrahæ.
For the Lord had closed every womb of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah, the wife of Abraham.
